entries.benchmark: NVDA absolute; Nasdaq/SOX relative if available
entries.variant_view: A beat is already consensus, and the stock fell over T+3 in three of the last four reports despite EPS beats; DSO and cash conversion give the market a quality excuse to sell the news.
entries.invalidation: T+1 gain above 8%, DSO below 60 with data-center guide up more than 10%, gross-margin guide above 72%, or T+3 close above 180.

entries.variant_view: Revenue has stabilised but gross margin, profit and cash flow have not; three of the last four reports fell over T+3 despite EPS beats.
entries.invalidation: T+1 gain above 6%, gross-margin guide above 44% with inventory days below 95, or T+3 close above 42.
